name: 天气助手
description: 天气助手模块，支持查询城市当前天气、多日天气预报，以及今天和明天的气温/天气变化预警；当用户询问穿衣、出行、带伞、温差时，把核心建议放在主输出顶部，使用 Open-Meteo 免费 API，无需密钥
description_en: Weather assistant module for current weather, multi-day forecasts, and today-vs-tomorrow alerts. When users ask about clothing, travel, umbrellas, or temperature changes, it highlights practical advice at the top of the main output using the free Open-Meteo API.

permissions.name: android.permission.INTERNET
permissions.desc: 用于查询天气 API 获取天气数据
permissions.desc_en: Access weather API for weather data

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
permissions.desc: 用于获取精确位置以查询当前位置天气
permissions.desc_en: Get precise location for local weather

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
permissions.desc: 用于获取大致位置以查询当前位置天气
permissions.desc_en: Get approximate location for local weather

apis.name: getCurrentWeather
apis.desc: 查询指定城市的当前天气；city 为空时自动使用 GPS 定位获取当地天气
apis.desc_en: Get current weather for a city; if city is empty, auto-detect location via GPS
paramDesc: 城市名称（可选，留空则自动定位）
paramDesc_en: City name (optional, empty to use GPS location)

apis.name: getForecast
apis.desc: 查询指定城市未来多日天气预报；city 为空时自动使用 GPS 定位
apis.desc_en: Get multi-day forecast; if city is empty, auto-detect location via GPS
paramDesc: 城市名称（可选，留空则自动定位）
paramDesc_en: City name (optional, empty to use GPS location)

apis.name: getTemperatureAlert
apis.desc: 统计当前、今天和明天的天气及气温差异，按变化等级返回绿色/蓝色/橙色/红色预警。用户问穿衣、带伞、出行、温差、明天是否变冷/变热时优先调用；请把用户原话或关注点传入 focus/question，模块会在主输出顶部突出穿衣建议、出行提醒、降水/风力和温差判断，不要只把建议藏在详情里。
apis.desc_en: Compare current, today, and tomorrow weather/temperature and return green/blue/orange/red alerts. Use this first when users ask about clothing, umbrellas, travel, temperature differences, or whether tomorrow is warmer/cooler. Pass the user's wording or focus via focus/question so the module can put clothing advice, travel reminders, rain/wind, and temperature-change judgment at the top of the main output.
paramDesc: 城市名称（可选，留空则自动定位）
用户关注点（可选）：如 穿衣、出行、带伞、温差、运动、通勤；LLM 应按用户描述填写，用于调整主输出重点顺序
用户原始问题（可选）：用于模块判断哪些天气数据应优先展示
paramDesc_en: City name (optional, empty to use GPS location)
User focus (optional), such as clothing, travel, umbrella, temperature change, outdoor activity, or commute; LLM should fill this from the user's wording to prioritize output order
Original user question (optional), used to decide which weather fields should be highlighted first
examples: 根据今天和明天的天气给我穿衣建议
今天出门要不要带伞？顺便说下穿什么
Compare today and tomorrow weather in Shanghai and tell me what to wear

apis.name: getWeatherByLocation
apis.desc: 根据经纬度坐标查询天气，用于已知坐标的场景

apis.name: openPage
apis.desc: 打开天气助手界面并返回 _openModule 信号
apis.desc_en: Open Weather UI and return _openModule signal
